:::{#exm-cross-entropy-continuous}
#### Cross-entropy of two densities on the unit interval

Let $p(x) = 1$ and $q(x) = 2x$ for $0 < x < 1$ be [densities](random-variables.qmd#def-pdf).
By @thm-cross-entropy-continuous, using the natural logarithm,

$$
\ba
\crossentropyf{p}{q}
&= -\int_0^1 \log (2x) \, dx \\
&= -\log 2 - \int_0^1 \log x \, dx \\
&= -\log 2 + 1 \\
&\approx 0.307 \text{ nats}.
\ea
$$
